title: adx_externalidentity
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): adx_contactid, createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid.

adx_username.description: Shows the name of the custom entity.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

importsequencenumber.description: Shows the sequence number of the import that created this record.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was modified.

overriddencreatedon.description: Shows the date and time that the record was migrated.

statecode.description: Shows whether the external identity is active or inactive.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Shows the time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_adx_contactid_value.description: Unique identifier for Contact associated with External Identity.

_createdby_value.description: Shows the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows the delegate user who modified the record.
